provider_selection.notes: Provider keys and model access are valid dependencies for approved first-party model providers; they are not project deletion criteria.

reserve_candidates.name: video-shotcraft
reserve_candidates.notes: Adapter and Remotion smoke render are complete. Reuse shot cards, real-page capture, PageCam, deterministic motion, beat/SFX timing and final review through the Newma VOX Adapter; product-promo defaults never replace Newma narration and evidence rules.

reserve_candidates.name: openchatcut
reserve_candidates.notes: Keep the upstream repository intact. Newma owns Run Control, review, Artifact Lineage and handoff; OpenChatCut owns the live timeline during the editor session. Human and Agent edits share EditorCore commands through the external MCP proposal workflow.

reserve_candidates.name: gsap-skills
reserve_candidates.notes: Keep one director-facing GSAP Suite entry and dispatch internally to eight subskills. Registering eight equal top-level entries would create routing noise and duplicate existing web-animation guidance.

reserve_candidates.name: impeccable
reserve_candidates.notes: Best used to audit and polish HTML storyboards, charts and title systems before recording. It complements rather than replaces design-taste-frontend and the dedicated animation-review skills.

reserve_candidates.name: video-autopilot-kit
reserve_candidates.notes: Strong self-media operations candidate for batch production and CapCut handoff, but it is a project rather than an installable Skill today. Keep blocked from direct routing until an adapter, output guard and smoke test exist.

reserve_candidates.name: mixpost
reserve_candidates.notes: Its platform analytics surface is more useful than rebuilding account dashboards. Newma should keep Run Control and normalize only approved metrics into performance_dataset.

reserve_candidates.name: 4cat
reserve_candidates.notes: Best fit for the competitor benchmark node. Keep the upstream service intact and exchange CSV/JSON datasets rather than copying its analysis modules into Newma.

reserve_candidates.name: zeeschuimer
reserve_candidates.notes: Register as a 4CAT companion instead of a separate primary workflow choice. Human-visible capture is useful when platform APIs do not expose competitor data.

reserve_candidates.name: minet
reserve_candidates.notes: Use as the low-coupling CLI collector for public competitor discovery. Output must be normalized into competitor_dataset with source URLs and collection timestamps.

reserve_candidates.name: tiktok-api
reserve_candidates.notes: Unofficial endpoints can change. Keep it optional behind the platform metrics adapter and retain manual/browser fallback.

reserve_candidates.name: twscrape
reserve_candidates.notes: Useful for public X comparison data, but account and rate-limit handling must remain outside the shared Newma artifact model.

reserve_candidates.name: youtube-operational-api
reserve_candidates.notes: Official YouTube Data and Analytics APIs remain primary. This project is only a public-data fallback when the official API cannot satisfy competitor lookup.

reserve_candidates.name: bertopic
reserve_candidates.notes: Use after comments are collected and normalized. It should enrich experiment_findings, not become a separate user-facing workflow.

reserve_candidates.name: wechatpy
reserve_candidates.notes: Use the official WeChat datacube interfaces through wechatpy for owned accounts. Keep account credentials in the publish adapter and write only normalized metrics plus evidence timestamps.

reserve_candidates.name: mediacrawler
reserve_candidates.notes: Primary reserve for Xiaohongshu, Douyin, Kuaishou, Bilibili, Weibo, Tieba and Zhihu competitor collection. Run at low frequency and preserve raw snapshots because login and page changes are expected.

reserve_candidates.name: yt-dlp
reserve_candidates.notes: Use for public competitor metadata, captions, thumbnails and review samples. It is not an owned-account analytics source and must not replace platform screenshots.

reserve_candidates.name: pyabsa
reserve_candidates.notes: Separate opinions about title, hook, data, visuals and narration. Chinese internet slang and finance language require calibration and human review.

reserve_candidates.name: dowhy
reserve_candidates.notes: Do not run causal claims on one or a few works. Enable only after Newma has repeated experiments, explicit treatment variables and enough comparable samples.

projects.name: postbot
projects.notes: Default branch depends on unpublished @gitcoffee packages; the public-dependency 1.1.20 branch is installed and built.

projects.name: talking-head-editor
projects.notes: Retained because explicitly requested; no clear license and no native Codex Skill.

projects.name: claude-code-video-toolkit
projects.notes: Retain only the local Remotion templates, transitions, components, data-visualization examples and browser-recording patterns. Modal, RunPod, ElevenLabs, R2 and other third-party cloud routes are excluded from routing.

projects.name: taste-skill
projects.notes: Already retained and installed. Reuse as the anti-slop art-direction advisor; do not duplicate it from the newer catalog.

projects.name: baoyu-skills
projects.notes: Image, cover and infographic routes are retained. Director calls must explicitly select an allowed first-party provider and must not auto-route to third-party aggregators.

projects.name: minimax-skills
projects.notes: Retain both local design guidance and model-backed BrandKit/image-to-code workflows. Official MiniMax or other allowlisted model access is valid; third-party aggregators are excluded.

projects.name: inference-skills
projects.notes: Registered only for local design and animation guidance; external inference model routes are excluded.

rejected.name: ffmpeg-usage
rejected.reason: No stable independent upstream; covered by the internal FFmpeg toolkit.

rejected.name: caption-clip
rejected.reason: Low adoption, no clear license, and duplicated caption capability.

rejected.name: product-launch-video-skill
rejected.reason: Niche and lower quality than retained Remotion toolkits.

rejected.name: rednote-mcp
rejected.reason: Duplicated by the retained xiaohongshu-mcp and stronger browser/API routes.

rejected.name: x-cli
rejected.reason: Duplicated by xurl and existing publishing routes.

rejected.name: boutique/video-subtitles
rejected.reason: Hebrew/English-oriented and unsuitable for the Chinese primary workflow.

rejected.name: boutique/demo-video
rejected.reason: Depends on obsolete Clawdbot browser paths.

rejected.name: boutique/video-agent
rejected.reason: Documentation-only HeyGen API wrapper with no installable upstream.

rejected.name: boutique/animation-duplicates
rejected.reason: Materially duplicated by retained Remotion, HyperFrames, Lottie and animation-review Skills.

rejected.name: governed-dcf-skill
rejected.reason: Useful finance methodology but weak fit for video generation or self-media operations; upstream has no declared license, so keep outside the executable reserve.

rejected.name: livo-redskill-p5-attachments
rejected.reason: No stable public upstream or license was verified. Generic procedural-motion ideas are already covered by algorithmic-art and GSAP; do not register as executable.
